meta.notes: A rod that faces any of six ways, as a lightning rod; it gives no light (msm:light_emitter 0). Lightning that strikes near the metal scrapes it back a stage, as it does copper. Mined with a stone pickaxe or better, as copper. Bronze Rod: on random ticks it slowly ages into the exposed stage, msm_examples:exposed_bronze_rod, by copper's own chance, and a lower-stage neighbour holds it back. Honeycomb waxes it into msm_examples:waxed_bronze_rod.
